top_signals.title: Ivanhoe Electric (IE) in Talks to Sell Arizona Copper Amid Data Center Demand
top_signals.summary: Ivanhoe Electric Inc. is in advanced talks with prospective buyers for copper from its project in Arizona, as the rapid expansion of data centers and power grids stokes demand for the metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
